scanNote:
WORKBOOK 61-BET. Unit 15 — uch bosqichli harakat, Present Perfect.

Skaner bilan tekshirildi. HAMMASI TO'G'RI: 7-mashq (9 rasm), 8-mashq (jadval + savol-javob + gaplar), 9-mashq (8 tanlov), 10-mashq (14 fe'l) — jami 40 dan ortiq javob.

⚠ 7-MAShQNING SIRI — UCh HARAKAT, HAR BIRI UCh BOSQIChDA:
  A) o'simlikka suv quyish: 1 hali boshlamagan (going to) → 2 qilayapti (Continuous) → 3 tugatgan (Present Perfect)
  B) nonushta: 4 → 5 → 6 (xuddi shu tartib)
  C) ko'chadan o'tish: 7 → 8 → 9 (xuddi shu tartib)
  ⚠ Ya'ni to'qqiz rasm — uchta uchlik. Har uchlikda BIR XIL tartib takrorlanadi.
  ⚠ Rasmlarni ajratish belgilari: 1 suv idishini olyapti (hali quymagan) · 3 kresloda dam olyapti (ish tugagan) · 6 likopchalar bo'sh · 9 ayol narigi tomonda.

⚠ 9-MAShQ — EVER va NEVER:
  EVER — SAVOLDA ('Have you EVER been...?') va orttirma daraja bilan ('the most comfortable hotel I've EVER stayed at')
  NEVER — TASDIQ gapda inkor ma'noda ('Melanie has NEVER been...')
  ⚠ 'never' o'zi inkor, shuning uchun 'hasn't never' XATO.

⚠ 9-MAShQ — YET va ALREADY:
  YET — INKOR va SAVOLDA, gap OXIRIDA ('hasn't left YET')
  ALREADY — TASDIQ gapda, fe'l OLDIDA ('have ALREADY visited')

⚠ 9-MAShQ — FOR va SINCE: 'for two weeks' (muddat) · 'since he was five' (boshlanish nuqtasi).

⚠ 10-MAShQ — UCh ZAMON ARALASh: Present Perfect ('Have you been', 'have been'), Past Simple ('went', 'bought', 'arrived'), Present Continuous ('are you doing', 'am having', 'am going'), Present Simple ('does Mike live', 'lives') va 'be going to' ('am going to buy').
  ⚠ 1-band naqshi: 'HAVE you BEEN...?' (tajriba) → 'I WENT there YESTERDAY' (aniq vaqt bor → Past Simple).

exercises.instructionEn: Put the correct caption under each picture.
exercises.instructionUz: Har bir rasm ostiga to'g'ri izohni qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'QQIZ IZOH, TO'QQIZ RASM.

⚠ MAShQNING SIRI — UCh HARAKAT, HAR BIRI
UCh BOSQIChDA:

  A) O'SIMLIKKA SUV QUYISh (erkak)
     1  hali boshlamagan  → GOING TO
     2  qilayapti          → CONTINUOUS
     3  tugatgan           → PRESENT PERFECT

  B) NONUShTA (ayol)
     4  hali boshlamagan  → GOING TO
     5  qilayapti          → CONTINUOUS
     6  tugatgan           → PRESENT PERFECT

  C) KO'ChADAN O'TISh (ayol)
     7  hali boshlamagan  → GOING TO
     8  qilayapti          → CONTINUOUS
     9  tugatgan           → PRESENT PERFECT


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

  1  He's GOING TO WATER the plants.
  2  He IS WATERING the plants.
  3  He HAS WATERED the plants.

  4  She's GOING TO HAVE breakfast.
  5  She's HAVING breakfast.
  6  She HAS HAD breakfast.

  7  She IS GOING TO CROSS the street.
  8  She IS CROSSING the street.
  9  She HAS CROSSED the street.


RASMLARDA NIMA KO'RINADI:

  1  Erkak cho'kkalab, suv idishini olyapti
     (hali suv quymagan)
  2  Erkak tuvakdagi o'simlikka suv quyyapti
  3  Erkak kresloda dam olyapti, suv idishi
     yonida (ish tugagan)

  4  Ayol oshxonada ovqat tayyorlayapti
     (hali yemagan)
  5  Ayol stolda o'tirib ovqatlanyapti
  6  Ayol stol yonida turibdi, likopchalar
     bo'sh (yeb bo'lgan)

  7  Ayol yo'lakda turibdi, ko'chaga qarayapti
     (hali o'tmagan)
  8  Ayol zebra bo'ylab yuryapti
  9  Ayol narigi tomonda, kimdir bilan
     ko'rishyapti (o'tib bo'lgan)


⚠ UCh ZAMONNING MA'NOSI:

  BE GOING TO — REJA, hali boshlanmagan
     'He's GOING TO water the plants.'
     = suv quymoqchi (hali quymagan)

  PRESENT CONTINUOUS — HOZIR davom etyapti
     'He IS WATERING the plants.'
     = suv quyayapti (ayni damda)

  PRESENT PERFECT — TUGAGAN, natijasi bor
     'He HAS WATERED the plants.'
     = suv quyib bo'lgan (o'simliklar ho'l)


DIQQAT — 5 va 6-BANDLARDAGI 'HAVE':

  5  'She's HAVING breakfast.'
     'have' bu yerda = YEMOQ, shuning uchun
     Continuous BO'LADI.

  6  'She HAS HAD breakfast.'
     IKKI marta 'have':
        'HAS' — yordamchi fe'l
        'HAD' — asosiy fe'l (V3)

  DIQQAT: 'have' EGALIK ma'nosida Continuous
  bo'lmaydi ('I am having a car' XATO),
  lekin 'yemoq' ma'nosida BO'LADI
  ('I am having breakfast' ✓).


DIQQAT — 'CROSS' VA 'WATER' — HAR IKKALASI
HAM FE'L:
  'to cross the street' = ko'chadan o'tmoq
  'to water the plants' = o'simlikka suv
     quymoq

  'water' — ham OT (suv), ham FE'L (suv
  quymoq).


V3 ShAKLLARI:
  water → watered → WATERED  (to'g'ri)
  have  → had     → HAD      (V2 = V3)
  cross → crossed → CROSSED  (to'g'ri)


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a caption   = izoh (rasm ostidagi)
  to water    = suv quymoq
  a plant     = o'simlik
  a watering can = suv idishi (leyka)
  to cross    = kesib o'tmoq
  breakfast   = nonushta

pairs.right: He's going to water the plants.
pairs.whyUz:
REJA, hali boshlanmagan → BE GOING TO.

Erkak suv idishini endi olyapti — hali
quymagan.

HOZIR davom etyapti → PRESENT CONTINUOUS.

'to water' — bu yerda FE'L (suv quymoq),
'water' oti emas.

pairs.left: 3  Erkak kresloda dam olyapti, ish tugagan
pairs.whyUz:
TUGAGAN, natijasi bor → PRESENT PERFECT.

water → watered → WATERED (to'g'ri fe'l,
V2 = V3).

REJA, hali yemagan → BE GOING TO.

'to have breakfast' = nonushta qilmoq.

HOZIR davom etyapti → PRESENT CONTINUOUS.

⚠ DIQQAT: 'have' EGALIK ma'nosida Continuous
bo'lmaydi, lekin 'YEMOQ' ma'nosida BO'LADI:
  'She is HAVING breakfast.'  ✓
  'She is HAVING a car.'      ✗

TUGAGAN → PRESENT PERFECT.

⚠ IKKI marta 'have':
  'HAS' — yordamchi fe'l
  'HAD' — asosiy fe'l (V3)

have → had → HAD (V2 = V3).

pairs.right: She is going to cross the street.
pairs.whyUz:
REJA, hali o'tmagan → BE GOING TO.

'to cross the street' = ko'chadan o'tmoq.

HOZIR davom etyapti → PRESENT CONTINUOUS.

Rasmda zebra chiziqlari aniq ko'rinadi.

pairs.left: 9  Ayol narigi tomonda, kimdir bilan ko'rishyapti
pairs.whyUz:
TUGAGAN, natijasi bor (u narigi tomonda)
→ PRESENT PERFECT.

cross → crossed → CROSSED (to'g'ri fe'l).

exercises.instructionEn: a) Work in pairs. Ask and answer questions about the people, as in the example.  b) Now, write sentences about the people, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: a) Juftlikda ishlang. Odamlar haqida namunadagidek savol-javob qiling.  b) Endi odamlar haqida namunadagidek gaplar yozing.
exercises.explanationUz:
JADVAL — UCh EGA, TO'RT ISh:

                go to  eat      travel  ride a
                Italy  Chinese  by      horse
                       food     plane
  ─────────────  ─────  ───────  ──────  ──────
  Greg             ✗      ✓        ✓       ✗
  Tina             ✓      ✗        ✗       ✓
  Mr & Mrs Brown   ✓      ✗        ✓       ✗


═══ 8a) SAVOL-JAVOB ═══

KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  SA: HAS Greg BEEN to Italy?
  SB: No, he HASN'T.
  SA: HAS he EATEN Chinese food?
  SB: Yes, he HAS.


BARCHA SAVOL-JAVOBLAR:

 GREG:
  Has Greg been to Italy?      — No, he hasn't.
  Has he eaten Chinese food?   — Yes, he has.
  Has he travelled by plane?   — Yes, he has.
  Has he ridden a horse?       — No, he hasn't.

 TINA:
  Has Tina been to Italy?      — Yes, she has.
  Has she eaten Chinese food?  — No, she hasn't.
  Has she travelled by plane?  — No, she hasn't.
  Has she ridden a horse?      — Yes, she has.

 MR & MRS BROWN:
  Have Mr and Mrs Brown been to Italy?
                               — Yes, they have.
  Have they eaten Chinese food?
                               — No, they haven't.
  Have they travelled by plane?
                               — Yes, they have.
  Have they ridden a horse?
                               — No, they haven't.


═══ 8b) GAPLAR ═══

KITOBDAGI NAMUNA (Greg):
  'Greg HASN'T BEEN to Italy, BUT he HAS EATEN
   Chinese food. He HAS ALSO TRAVELLED by
   plane, BUT he HASN'T RIDDEN a horse.'


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

 TINA:
  'Tina HAS BEEN to Italy, BUT she HASN'T
   EATEN Chinese food. She HASN'T TRAVELLED by
   plane, BUT she HAS RIDDEN a horse.'

 MR & MRS BROWN:
  'Mr and Mrs Brown HAVE BEEN to Italy, BUT
   they HAVEN'T EATEN Chinese food. They HAVE
   ALSO TRAVELLED by plane, BUT they HAVEN'T
   RIDDEN a horse.'


⚠ UCh MUHIM NUQTA:

 1) 'GO TO ITALY' → 'HAVE BEEN TO':
    Namuna 'Has Greg BEEN to Italy?' deydi,
    'GONE' emas!

    Chunki jadvalda TAJRIBA haqida
    so'ralyapti (borib qaytish).
    Workbook 60-bet, 6-mashq qoidasi:
       'have BEEN to' = tajriba
       'have GONE to' = hali u yerda

 2) 'MR & MRS BROWN' — KO'PLIK:
    'HAVE they been ...?'  ✓
    'HAS they been ...?'   ✗
    Olmoshi: THEY.

 3) 'ALSO' NING O'RNI:
    Namunada: 'He HAS ALSO TRAVELLED by
    plane.'
    'also' — 'has' va V3 ORASIDA.

    DIQQAT: Tina uchun 'also' KERAK EMAS,
    chunki uning uchinchi ishi INKOR
    ('She HASN'T travelled by plane').


V3 ShAKLLARI:
  go     →  BEEN (bu holatda)
  eat    →  EATEN
  travel →  TRAVELLED (britancha, IKKI 'L')
  ride   →  RIDDEN

  DIQQAT: 'eaten' va 'ridden' — '-EN' bilan.


GRAMMAR 65-BET BILAN SOLIShTIRING:
  U yerda AYNAN shunday jadval bor edi:
     Tom / Andrea / The Smiths
     go to the opera, eat Mexican food,
     travel to Europe, take a boat trip

  Bu yerda esa:
     Greg / Tina / Mr & Mrs Brown
     go to Italy, eat Chinese food,
     travel by plane, ride a horse

  Tuzilishi AYNAN bir xil — kitob ataylab
  takrorlagan.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  Italy       = Italiya
  Chinese food = xitoy taomi
  by plane    = samolyotda
  to ride a horse = ot minmoq

points.en: SA: Has Greg been to Italy?  SB: No, he hasn't.  SA: Has he eaten Chinese food?  SB: Yes, he has.
points.uz: SA: Greg Italiyaga borganmi? SB: Yo'q. SA: Xitoy taomini yeb ko'rganmi? SB: Ha.
points.noteUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA (8a).

⚠ 'BEEN to Italy' — 'gone' EMAS!
Jadvalda TAJRIBA haqida so'ralyapti.

points.en: Has Tina been to Italy? — Yes, she has.  Has she eaten Chinese food? — No, she hasn't.  Has she travelled by plane? — No, she hasn't.  Has she ridden a horse? — Yes, she has.
points.uz: Tina Italiyaga borganmi? — Ha. Xitoy taomini yeb ko'rganmi? — Yo'q. Samolyotda uchganmi? — Yo'q. Ot minganmi? — Ha.

points.en: Have Mr and Mrs Brown been to Italy? — Yes, they have.  Have they eaten Chinese food? — No, they haven't.
points.uz: Missis va mister Braun Italiyaga borishganmi? — Ha. Xitoy taomini yeb ko'rishganmi? — Yo'q.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'Mr & Mrs Brown' — KO'PLIK!
'HAVE they ...?' ✓ / 'HAS they ...?' ✗
Olmoshi: THEY.

points.en: Greg hasn't been to Italy, but he has eaten Chinese food. He has also travelled by plane, but he hasn't ridden a horse.
points.uz: Greg Italiyaga bormagan, lekin xitoy taomini yeb ko'rgan. Samolyotda ham uchgan, lekin ot minmagan.
points.noteUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA (8b).

'BUT' — ✓ va ✗ ni qarama-qarshi qo'yadi.
'ALSO' — 'has' va V3 ORASIDA.

points.en: Tina has been to Italy, but she hasn't eaten Chinese food. She hasn't travelled by plane, but she has ridden a horse.
points.uz: Tina Italiyaga borgan, lekin xitoy taomini yeb ko'rmagan. Samolyotda uchmagan, lekin ot mingan.
points.noteUz:
Jadval: ✓ ✗ ✗ ✓

DIQQAT: bu yerda 'also' KERAK EMAS, chunki
uchinchi ish INKOR.

points.en: Mr and Mrs Brown have been to Italy, but they haven't eaten Chinese food. They have also travelled by plane, but they haven't ridden a horse.
points.uz: Braunlar Italiyaga borishgan, lekin xitoy taomini yeb ko'rishmagan. Samolyotda ham uchishgan, lekin ot minishmagan.
points.noteUz:
Jadval: ✓ ✗ ✓ ✗

KO'PLIK: HAVE / HAVEN'T, olmoshi THEY.
Uchinchi ish TASDIQ, shuning uchun 'ALSO'
kerak.

exercises.explanationUz:
BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  EVER
  2  YET
  3  FOR
  4  ALREADY
  5  NEVER
  6  JUST
  7  SINCE
  8  EVER


HAR BIRI NEGA:

 1  'HAVE YOU ... been to Lisbon?'
    Bu SAVOL → EVER.

 2  'Flight 201 ... HASN'T LEFT ...'
    INKOR gap → YET (gap oxirida).

 3  'John has been here ... TWO WEEKS.'
    'two weeks' — DAVOMIYLIK → FOR.

 4  'We have ... visited the Science Museum.'
    TASDIQ gap → ALREADY.
    ('yet' tasdiqda ishlatilmaydi.)

 5  'Melanie has ... been to a concert ...'
    TASDIQ shakl, INKOR ma'no → NEVER.
    ('ever' oddiy tasdiq gapda
     ishlatilmaydi.)

 6  'Yes, I've ... booked one.'
    TASDIQ javob → JUST (hozirgina).
    ('yet' tasdiqda ishlatilmaydi.)

 7  'Peter hasn't travelled by boat ...
     HE WAS FIVE YEARS OLD.'
    ⚠ KALIT: keyin TO'LIQ GAP keladi
    ('he was five years old').
    'since' dan keyin GAP kelishi mumkin,
    'for' dan keyin esa faqat vaqt miqdori.
    → SINCE

 8  'This is the MOST COMFORTABLE hotel I've
     ... stayed at.'
    KALIT: 'THE MOST COMFORTABLE' — USTUN
    DARAJA → EVER.


⚠ 7-BAND — ENG NOZIK:

  'since' dan keyin IKKI xil narsa kelishi
  mumkin:
     1) VAQT NUQTASI: 'since Monday',
        'since 1992'
     2) TO'LIQ GAP: 'since he was five years
        old', 'since I came here'

  'for' dan keyin esa FAQAT vaqt miqdori:
     'for two weeks', 'for five years'
     'for he was five years old' — XATO!

  Grammar 65-bet: 'I've been here SINCE I
  ARRIVED.'


⚠ 8-BAND — USTUN DARAJA QURILMASI:
  'the MOST COMFORTABLE hotel I've EVER
   stayed at'

  Bu qurilma butun unitda TO'RT marta
  uchraydi:
     CB 106: 'the best place I've ever
              visited'
     GB 66:  'the best place I've ever
              visited'
     GB 67:  'the best hamburger I've ever had'
     WB 61:  'the most comfortable hotel I've
              ever stayed at'


DIQQAT — 8-BANDDAGI PREDLOG:
  'the hotel I've ever STAYED AT'
  'stay AT a hotel' — predlog 'at' gap
  OXIRIDA qoladi.

  To'liq shakli: 'the hotel AT WHICH I've
  ever stayed' (juda rasmiy).


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  Lisbon      = Lissabon (Portugaliya
                poytaxti)
  a flight    = parvoz
  the Science Museum = Fan muzeyi
  a concert   = konsert
  the Royal Albert Hall = Londondagi mashhur
                konsert zali
  comfortable = qulay
  to stay at  = ... da turmoq

items.textEn: 1  Have you never/ever been to Lisbon?
items.whyUz:
KALIT: bu SAVOL ('Have you ...?') → EVER.

Savolda DOIM 'ever' ishlatiladi.

Lisbon — Portugaliya poytaxti.

items.textEn: 2  Flight 201 for New York hasn't left yet/already.
items.whyUz:
KALIT: 'HASN'T' — INKOR gap → YET.

'already' INKORDA ishlatilmaydi.
'yet' — GAP OXIRIDA.

leave → LEFT (V2 = V3).

items.textEn: 3  John has been here for/since two weeks.
items.uz: Jon ikki haftadan beri shu yerda.
items.whyUz:
'two weeks' — RAQAM + VAQT BIRLIGI
→ DAVOMIYLIK → FOR.

Savol: 'qancha vaqt?' → ikki hafta.

items.textEn: 4  We have yet/already visited the Science Museum.
items.whyUz:
TASDIQ gap ('We have visited') → ALREADY.

'yet' TASDIQ gapda ishlatilmaydi.
'already' — 'have' va V3 ORASIDA.

items.textEn: 5  Melanie has ever/never been to a concert at the Royal Albert Hall.
items.uz: Melani Royal Albert Hall'dagi konsertda hech qachon bo'lmagan.
items.whyUz:
Gap TASDIQ shaklda ('has been'), lekin ma'no
INKOR → NEVER.

'ever' oddiy TASDIQ gapda ISHLATILMAYDI
(faqat savolda yoki ustun daraja bilan).

the Royal Albert Hall — Londondagi mashhur
konsert zali.

items.textEn: 6  A: Have you booked a hotel room?  B: Yes, I've just/yet booked one.
items.whyUz:
TASDIQ javob ('Yes, I've booked') → JUST.

'yet' TASDIQ gapda ISHLATILMAYDI.
'just' = hozirgina, 'have' va V3 ORASIDA.

'book a room' = xona band qilmoq.

items.textEn: 7  Peter hasn't travelled by boat for/since he was five years old.
items.uz: Piter besh yoshidan beri qayiqda sayohat qilmagan.
items.whyUz:
⚠ ENG NOZIK BAND — KEYIN TO'LIQ GAP KELADI:
'... HE WAS five years old.'

'SINCE' dan keyin GAP kelishi mumkin;
'FOR' dan keyin esa FAQAT vaqt miqdori:
  'since he was five'  ✓
  'for he was five'    ✗

Grammar 65-bet: 'I've been here SINCE I
ARRIVED.'

items.textEn: 8  This is the most comfortable hotel I've never/ever stayed at.
items.uz: Bu men turgan eng qulay mehmonxona.
items.whyUz:
KALIT: 'THE MOST COMFORTABLE' — USTUN
DARAJA → EVER.

Bu qurilma butun unitda TO'RT marta uchraydi:
  CB 106: 'the best place I've ever visited'
  GB 66:  'the best place I've ever visited'
  GB 67:  'the best hamburger I've ever had'
  WB 61:  bu band

'stay AT a hotel' — predlog gap oxirida
qoladi.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the gaps with the correct form of the verbs in brackets.
exercises.instructionUz: Bo'shliqlarni qavs ichidagi fe'llarning to'g'ri shakli bilan to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
OLTI DIALOG — BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

 1  A: HAVE YOU BEEN to the bazaar yet?
    B: Yes, I WENT there yesterday.
       I BOUGHT some souvenirs.

 2  A: What ARE YOU DOING tonight? Would you
       like to go to the cinema?
    B: I'm sorry, I can't. I AM HAVING dinner
       with some friends.

 3  A: How long HAVE YOU BEEN here?
    B: We HAVE BEEN here for three days.
       We ARRIVED on Monday morning.

 4  A: Where DOES MIKE LIVE?
    B: He LIVES in the city centre.

 5  A: HAVE YOU VISITED them yet?
    B: No, not yet. I AM GOING there this
       afternoon.

 6  A: HAVE YOU BOUGHT the tickets yet?
    B: No, I haven't. I AM GOING TO BUY them
       this afternoon.


HAR BIRI NEGA:

 1a 'YET' → PRESENT PERFECT savoli.
    'go' → 'BEEN' (borib qaytish, tajriba).
    → HAVE YOU BEEN

 1b 'YESTERDAY' → ANIQ VAQT → PAST SIMPLE.
    → WENT

 1c O'sha safar haqida → PAST SIMPLE.
    buy → BOUGHT.

 2a 'TONIGHT' + reja haqida savol →
    PRESENT CONTINUOUS.
    → ARE YOU DOING

 2b 'I'm sorry, I can't' — sababi REJA bor →
    PRESENT CONTINUOUS.
    'have dinner' = kechki ovqat yemoq.
    → AM HAVING

 3a 'HOW LONG' → PRESENT PERFECT.
    → HAVE YOU BEEN

 3b 'FOR three days' → PRESENT PERFECT.
    → HAVE BEEN

 3c 'ON MONDAY MORNING' → ANIQ VAQT →
    PAST SIMPLE.
    → ARRIVED

 4a 'Where ... Mike live?' — DOIMIY holat
    (qayerda yashaydi) → PRESENT SIMPLE.
    'Mike' — III shaxs birlik → DOES.
    → DOES MIKE LIVE

 4b 'He ... in the city centre.'
    PRESENT SIMPLE, III shaxs → LIVES.

 5a 'YET' → PRESENT PERFECT savoli.
    → HAVE YOU VISITED

 5b 'THIS AFTERNOON' — yaqin kelajak REJA →
    PRESENT CONTINUOUS.
    → AM GOING

 6a 'YET' → PRESENT PERFECT savoli.
    buy → BOUGHT.
    → HAVE YOU BOUGHT

 6b 'THIS AFTERNOON' — REJA →
    BE GOING TO.
    → AM GOING TO BUY


⚠ 1a-BAND HAQIDA MUHIM IZOH:
  Qavsda '(you/go)' yozilgan, lekin javob
  'HAVE YOU BEEN'.

  Nega? Chunki B javob beradi: 'Yes, I WENT
  there YESTERDAY' — ya'ni borib QAYTGAN.

  Workbook 60-bet, 6-mashq qoidasi:
     'have BEEN to' = borib qaytgan
     'have GONE to' = hali u yerda


⚠ 5b va 6b — FARQI:

  5b  'I AM GOING there this afternoon.'
      → PRESENT CONTINUOUS (harakat 'go')

  6b  'I AM GOING TO BUY them this afternoon.'
      → BE GOING TO (harakat 'buy')

  Ikkalasida ham 'going' bor, lekin:
     5b — 'go' fe'lining o'zi
     6b — 'be going to' qurilmasi

  Bu — mashqning eng chalkash joyi!


⚠ 4-BAND — YAGONA PRESENT SIMPLE:
  Boshqa hamma dialoglar Present Perfect,
  Past Simple yoki kelajak haqida, lekin
  4-dialog DOIMIY holat haqida:
     'Where DOES Mike LIVE?'
     'He LIVES in the city centre.'

  'live' — doimiy holat, shuning uchun
  Present Simple.

  DIQQAT: savolda 'DOES ... LIVE' (asosiy
  shakl), javobda 'LIVES' (-S bilan).


DIQQAT — 'HAVE DINNER':
  'I am HAVING dinner with some friends.'
  'have' = yemoq → Continuous BO'LADI.

  Workbook 61-bet, 7-mashqda ham shu edi:
  'She's HAVING breakfast.'


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a bazaar    = sharq bozori
  the cinema  = kinoteatr
  to have dinner = kechki ovqat yemoq
  the city centre = shahar markazi
  this afternoon = bugun tushdan keyin
  a ticket    = chipta

commonMistake.whyUz:
KALIT: 'YET' → PRESENT PERFECT savoli.

⚠ 'BEEN', 'GONE' EMAS:
B javob beradi 'Yes, I WENT there YESTERDAY'
— ya'ni borib QAYTGAN.

Workbook 60-bet, 6-mashq qoidasi.

KALIT: 'YESTERDAY' — ANIQ VAQT
→ PAST SIMPLE.

go → WENT (V2).

O'sha safar haqida (kecha) → PAST SIMPLE.

buy → BOUGHT (V2 = V3).

Coursebook 105-bet: 'I BOUGHT some lovely
handmade souvenirs there.'

KALIT: 'TONIGHT' — kelajakdagi REJA haqida
savol → PRESENT CONTINUOUS.

Coursebook 107-bet, Madrid dialogi:
'What ARE YOU DOING tonight?' — aynan bir
xil savol.

items.sentence: 2b  B: I'm sorry, I can't. I ................................ (have) dinner with some friends.
items.uz: Kechirasiz, bo'lmaydi. Do'stlarim bilan kechki ovqat qilaman.

commonMistake.whyUz:
Rad etishning SABABI — allaqachon REJA bor
→ PRESENT CONTINUOUS.

⚠ 'have' = YEMOQ ma'nosida → Continuous
BO'LADI:
  'I am HAVING dinner.'  ✓
  'I am HAVING a car.'   ✗ (egalik)

items.uz: Bu yerda qancha vaqtdan beri turibsiz?

commonMistake.whyUz:
KALIT: 'HOW LONG' → PRESENT PERFECT.

be → BEEN (V3).

KALIT: 'FOR three days' → PRESENT PERFECT.

Ega 'We' → HAVE.

KALIT: 'ON MONDAY MORNING' — ANIQ VAQT
→ PAST SIMPLE.

⚠ 3b va 3c — UNIT 15 NING NAQSHI:
  3b  'We HAVE BEEN here for three days.'
      (Present Perfect — muddat)
  3c  'We ARRIVED on Monday morning.'
      (Past Simple — aniq vaqt)

DOIMIY holat (qayerda yashaydi)
→ PRESENT SIMPLE.

'Mike' — III shaxs birlik → DOES.

⚠ Savolda ASOSIY shakl:
  'Does Mike LIVE?'  ✓
  'Does Mike LIVES?' ✗

items.sentence: 4b  B: He ........................... (live) in the city centre.

commonMistake.whyUz:
PRESENT SIMPLE, ega 'He' — III shaxs birlik
→ LIVES (-S bilan).

DIQQAT: savolda 'live' (asosiy shakl),
javobda 'liveS' (-S bilan).

KALIT: 'YET' → PRESENT PERFECT savoli.

visit → VISITED (to'g'ri fe'l).

items.sentence: 5b  B: No, not yet. I ................................. (go) there this afternoon.
items.uz: Yo'q, hali. Bugun tushdan keyin boraman.

commonMistake.whyUz:
KALIT: 'THIS AFTERNOON' — yaqin kelajak REJA
→ PRESENT CONTINUOUS.

⚠ 6b BILAN SOLISHTIRING:
  5b  'I AM GOING there'      ('go' fe'li)
  6b  'I AM GOING TO BUY them' ('be going to')

Ikkalasida ham 'going' bor, lekin qurilmasi
BOSHQA!

KALIT: 'YET' → PRESENT PERFECT savoli.

buy → BOUGHT (V3).

items.uz: Yo'q. Ularni bugun tushdan keyin sotib olaman.

commonMistake.whyUz:
KALIT: 'THIS AFTERNOON' — REJA
→ BE GOING TO.

⚠ 5b BILAN FARQI:
  5b  'I AM GOING there' — 'go' fe'lining
      o'zi (Present Continuous)
  6b  'I AM GOING TO BUY them' — 'be going to'
      qurilmasi + 'buy'

Kitobda bo'shliq IKKI QATOR — uzun shakl
kerakligini ko'rsatadi.

wordFormation.introUz: Workbook 61-bet — uch zamon va Present Perfect ravishlari.

items.derived: He's going to water the plants.

groups.explanationUz: Ikkalasida ham 'going' bor, lekin qurilmasi boshqa.

items.base: I am GOING TO BUY them.

patterns.formula: He's GOING TO [fe'l]  →  He IS [fe'l]ING  →  He HAS [V3]
patterns.exampleEn: He's going to water the plants. He is watering the plants. He has watered the plants.
patterns.exampleUz: U suv quymoqchi. U suv quyayapti. U suv quyib bo'lgan.
patterns.explanationUz:
Bir harakatning UCH bosqichi:
reja → davom etyapti → tugagan.

patterns.exampleEn: Has Greg been to Italy? — No, he hasn't. Have Mr and Mrs Brown been to Italy? — Yes, they have.
patterns.exampleUz: Greg Italiyaga borganmi? — Yo'q. Braunlar borishganmi? — Ha.
patterns.explanationUz:
'Mr & Mrs Brown' — KO'PLIK → HAVE.
'go to' → 'BEEN to' (tajriba).

patterns.formula: [ega] HASN'T [V3] ..., BUT [ega] HAS [V3] ... . [ega] HAS ALSO [V3] ..., BUT ... .
patterns.exampleEn: Greg hasn't been to Italy, but he has eaten Chinese food. He has also travelled by plane, but he hasn't ridden a horse.
patterns.exampleUz: Greg Italiyaga bormagan, lekin xitoy taomini yeb ko'rgan. Samolyotda ham uchgan, lekin ot minmagan.
patterns.explanationUz:
'BUT' — ✓ va ✗ ni qarama-qarshi qo'yadi.
'ALSO' — 'has' va V3 ORASIDA (faqat
TASDIQ gapda).

patterns.exampleEn: Peter hasn't travelled by boat since he was five years old.
patterns.exampleUz: Piter besh yoshidan beri qayiqda sayohat qilmagan.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'SINCE' dan keyin GAP kelishi mumkin;
'FOR' dan keyin esa faqat vaqt miqdori.

patterns.formula: HAVE you [V3] ... YET?  —  Yes, I [V2] ... [ANIQ VAQT].  /  No, I'm GOING TO [V1] ... .
patterns.exampleEn: Have you bought the tickets yet? — No, I haven't. I am going to buy them this afternoon.
patterns.exampleUz: Chiptalarni oldingizmi? — Yo'q. Bugun tushdan keyin sotib olaman.
